item.title: Pocket Host 0.13.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • Pocket Host builds again, so 0.13's Google Cloud sign-in reaches the Mac: two of its libraries released new versions on 2026-10-12 that didn't build together.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.12.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • Pocket Voice (the iOS test) hears you now: the microphone's audio reaches Gemini also where the iPhone's echo cancellation delivers several channels or none at all. The helper says "Connecting to Gemini…" until it can talk, and Settings shows how the last conversation went.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.12.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • Pocket Voice, a test on iOS: a little helper on top of the app you talk to, for example in the car. It listens and answers through Google's Gemini Live API with your own key and works the app where you can see it: hops into workspaces, types into the message box, sends after you say yes, sums up what agents did. Hidden unless `pocket://voice?on` turns it on; not on Android yet.

    • Patch Changes

  • Pocket Host finds Tailscale even when it connects after Pocket Host started, for example right after login, so "Enable Tailscale Serve" shows up without restarting Pocket Host. It also finds Tailscale in other install locations, and if Tailscale is installed but not connected, the panel says so instead of "Tailscale not detected".
  • Pocket Voice (the iOS test) shows in Settings what it has cost so far today, this month and in total, estimated from the tokens Gemini reports.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.11.1
item.description:
Patch Changes

  • #53 `4c9baeb` Thanks @grischaerbe! - The workspace list no longer flashes "Can’t reach …" for a moment when you come back to the app: a connection error shows only once three loads in a row, a second apart, have failed. iPhone and Android alike.

item.title: Pocket Host 0.11.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • #49 `07550d7` Thanks @grischaerbe! - With a hardware keyboard, Enter in the message box sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, and ⌘↩ (Ctrl+Enter on Android) queues the message while the agent works, like in Conductor, or sends it otherwise. On iPad the suggestion bar of a hardware keyboard no longer covers the bottom of the message box.
  • #52 `344bf48` Thanks @grischaerbe! - When a chat has an unsent draft on the Mac, the message about it now has an "Overwrite" button: it clears the draft in Conductor and sends your message instead. iPhone and Android alike.

    • Patch Changes

  • #50 `c7896f1` Thanks @grischaerbe! - iPad: the sidebar stays open when you leave the app and come back.
